name: Miko Click and Collect
subtitle: In-store pickup at checkout, tracked through to collection
introduction: Let shoppers collect in store, and track every pickup order from placed to collected.
details: Let shoppers collect in store instead of waiting on delivery. Pickup appears at checkout on any store, listing your locations with their opening hours, preparation time and collection notes, so the shopper picks the one that suits them. Every pickup order arrives in one dashboard with its own status, from confirmed through packing to ready and collected. Your team moves an order along in one click and the shopper is emailed the moment it is ready. Uses the locations you already have.
features: Shoppers choose in-store pickup and their location during checkout.
Set opening hours, preparation time and collection notes per location.
Track pickup orders through confirmed, packing, ready and collected.
Email shoppers automatically when their order is ready to collect.
Handle pickup orders from the order page without leaving your admin.

testingInstructions:
Install on a development store that has at least one location with a full street address, and one product in stock at that location.

PLEASE READ FIRST: this app works on EVERY plan, not only Plus. It has no checkout UI extension and no theme block. Pickup is Shopify's own local pickup, which the app switches on for the locations the merchant links, so the pickup option and the store list are rendered by Shopify inside checkout on any plan. Nothing is added to the merchant's theme and no products are created in their store. Please do not restrict this listing to Plus merchants.

Walkthrough
1. Open the app. On Locations choose "Import from Shopify" to bring your store locations in as pickup points, or add one manually and link it to a location.
2. Open a location and set opening hours, preparation time and collection notes. If the Shopify location has no street address the app says so and explains why: Shopify matches pickup locations by how close they are to the customer, so one without an address is never offered.
3. Go to the storefront, add an in-stock product to the cart and open checkout. Choose Pickup. The location appears with its distance and the preparation time you set, rounded up to the nearest value Shopify supports.
4. Complete the order. It appears in the app under Orders within a few seconds, tagged click-collect, with the pickup location on the order and a note on the Shopify order.
5. Move the order from confirmed to packing, then to ready. Marking it ready emails the shopper with the address, the opening hours and what to bring. Then mark it collected.
6. Settings: choose which progress steps your team uses, set who the emails come from, and add your logo and color.

Data use: the app reads order and customer name, email and phone only to show the merchant who is collecting and to email that shopper when their order is ready. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
